Your queries and cluster information wil: Your queries and cluster information will be sent to the selected AI provider for processing. Please review your AI provider's privacy policy and ensure you comply with your organization's data policies.
You are responsible for monitoring your: You are responsible for monitoring your usage, managing costs, and ensuring compliance with your organization's policies when using AI features.
